headline: AnyPS5 Carries Console Code Across Platforms
lede: AnyPS5 turns PlayStation 5 executables toward native Linux and Windows execution instead of wrapping them in an emulator. Its relinker, PRX implementations, and SPIR-V shader recompiler make a practical research bench for preservationists and reverse engineers.

headline: Diagram Design Gives AI a Visual System
lede: Diagram Design supplies 29 self-contained HTML and SVG templates for producing polished technical graphics inside coding environments. Brand-aware tokens, Mermaid and draw.io conversion, and dependency-free output turn diagramming into a repeatable build process.

headline: REA Brings Evidence to Reverse Engineering
lede: REA connects AI agents and terminal workflows to local tools for examining binaries, applications, firmware, and packages. Its reports preserve evidence, limitations, and unknowns—an important safeguard when automated analysis enters sensitive territory.

headline: Skills Put Engineering Discipline Into Agents
lede: The Skills collection gives coding agents composable procedures for TDD, domain modeling, and requirements alignment. User-invoked commands make the workflow explicit, turning agent autonomy into a governed sequence of architectural checks.

headline: Claude-Mem Gives Coding Agents Long Memory
lede: Claude-Mem captures session activity, summarizes it semantically, and retrieves relevant history through SQLite and Chroma. Its search-to-timeline-to-detail flow keeps project context moving without forcing every past decision back into the prompt.

headline: RAD Debugger Rebuilds the Native Toolchain
lede: RAD Debugger pairs a native Windows debugger with a fast linker and a purpose-built representation for debug information. The result targets the hard edges of large C and C++ codebases: unwieldy binaries, slow links, and expensive debug cycles.

headline: Knowledge Plugins Turn Claude Into a Specialist
lede: Anthropic’s plugins define role-specific skills, commands, and connectors in plain JSON and Markdown. With MCP bridges into Jira, Slack, Notion, and data warehouses, teams can fit an assistant to established processes instead of rebuilding their organization around a generic chat window.

headline: ArtCraft Stages Generative Worlds Before Rendering
lede: ArtCraft places prompt-based image, video, audio, and 3D generation inside a visual desktop workspace. Canvases, cameras, characters, meshes, and compositing tools let creators compose a scene first, then choose the model that renders it.

headline: System Design Notes Maps the Interview Canon
lede: This study collection distills load balancing, caching, sharding, queues, and other architecture fundamentals into structured Markdown and diagrams. It gives candidates a compact reference for reviewing trade-offs before they have to explain a scalable system at the whiteboard.
